name: Orient Electric Ltd
title: Orient Electric Ltd - 541301 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q4 revenue up 10% to INR948 cr and EBITDA margin 8.2%, but gross margin fell to 31% on commodity inflation; calibrated price hikes (~6% in April) only partly offset costs and double-digit margin path is deferred.

triggers.label: April price hike ~6% across categories
triggers.quote: in April, we've taken about close to 6% price increase

triggers.label: Working capital days 23 to over 30
triggers.quote: our working capital days have increased. It's gone up to over 30 days from 23 days last year

triggers.label: Gross margin hit 100-150 bps from commodities
triggers.quote: it's impacted our gross margin, I would say, about 100, 150 basis points

triggers.label: Channel inventory elevated, dealers cautious
triggers.quote: Elevated channel inventory prompted dealers to approach replenishment with caution

guidance.quote: we've always given guidance of saying 32% to 34% should be our gross margin

guidance.horizon: over next 6 to 8 quarters (prior), now trending
guidance.quote: from a structural perspective, we are trending towards a double-digit margin
our journey towards INR5,000 crores and a double -digit EBITDA there

prior_guidance_check.quote: we have been unable to achieve the same

red_flags.label: Working capital days up 23 to 30+
red_flags.quote: our working capital days have increased. It's gone up to over 30 days from 23 days last year

red_flags.label: Double-digit margin target missed
red_flags.quote: we have been unable to achieve the same

evasions.topic: Price hike needed to offset full cost inflation
evasions.quote: It is not. And I will be very honest with you, the industry has not been able to do.

evasions.topic: Q1 primary vs secondary channel inventory
evasions.quote: So unfair for me to give you a real live quarter 1 update.
